thread.title: UPDATE: Female suspect dead, 4 injured in shooting at YouTube headquarters

author: morningstar.com
title: UPDATE: Female suspect dead, 4 injured in shooting at YouTube headquarters
text:
By Max A. Cherney
Victims transferred to hospitals; woman shot herself, police say
Police said late Tuesday one person died and four people were injured during a shooting at the YouTube headquarters in San Bruno, Calif.
The shooter was a woman who died of a self-inflicted gunshot wound, police said. Emergency personnel transported four victims suffering from gunshot wounds to nearby hospitals in San Francisco and Palo Alto.
Officers responded to the call at 12:48 p.m. local time and said the scene at YouTube remained an active investigation.
In a statement, Google said it was coordinating with authorities and had asked employees at other locations to avoid the area.
(https://twitter.com/Google_Comms/status/981283098443751424)
(https://twitter.com/Google_Comms/status/981283513713418240)
(https://twitter.com/Google_Comms/status/981283685306478592)
Zuckerberg San Francisco General Hospital spokesman Brent Andrew said at a news conference with reporters that it had received two female victims and one male who were undergoing treatment.
YouTube product manager Vadim Lavrusik tweeted that he heard shots fired, saw people running and barricaded himself in a room with co-workers. About 30 minutes later, Lavrusik said he had safely exited the building.
(https://twitter.com/Lavrusik/status/981259304408788993)
Todd Sherman, another YouTube employee, tweeted that he heard people running and while he was attempting to flee, saw blood on the floor and stairs. Sherman said he made it safely out and took a taxi home.
(https://twitter.com/tdd/status/981262648867143680)
Citing an anonymous law enforcement source, ABC7 News reported (http://abc7news.com/source-active-shooter-possible-injuries-at-youtube-in-san-bruno/3297411/) that the shooter was a white, adult female wearing a dark top and head scarf.
YouTube, which is a unit of Alphabet Inc .(GOOGL)(GOOGL) , employs about 2,000 people at its San Bruno offices.
President Donald Trump and Apple Inc. (AAPL) CEO Tim Cook expressed their condolences on Twitter.
-Max A. Cherney;
